# ankra_cluster_mesh_member (Resource)

A cluster's membership of a Cilium ClusterMesh. The counterpart of `ankra cluster mesh join` and `leave`. Run `ankra cluster mesh make-ready` (an operation, not managed here) before a cluster joins.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ankra_cluster_mesh" "edge" {
  name = "edge"
}

resource "ankra_cluster_mesh_member" "stockholm" {
  cluster_id = "0b6f1d2e-1111-4222-8333-944445555666"
  mesh_id    = ankra_cluster_mesh.edge.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String) Identifier of the cluster. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `mesh_id` (String) Identifier of the mesh. Changing it replaces the membership.

### Read-Only

- `cilium_cluster_id` (Number) Cilium cluster identity the cluster carries in the mesh.
- `cilium_cluster_name` (String) Cilium cluster name the cluster carries in the mesh.
- `id` (String) `<cluster_id>/<mesh_id>`.
- `status` (String) Membership status.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Memberships are imported by cluster id and mesh id.
terraform import ankra_cluster_mesh_member.stockholm 0b6f1d2e-1111-4222-8333-944445555666/9a8b7c6d-5e4f-4a3b-8c2d-1e0f9a8b7c6d
```
